name: U15-1-next-up-after-stop
steps: const h=window.__sim.host;const r=h.runs.find(r=>r.run_id===h.queue.writer);const t=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===r.task_id);r.state='reconciliation_required';t.state='reconciliation_required';h.emit({type:'run_upserted',run:r});h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task:t});h.queue.paused=true;h.queue.pause_reason='Next up paused when you stopped “'+t.title+'”, so nothing starts by itself. Resume when you’re ready.';h.emit({type:'queue_changed',queue:h.queue});

name: U15-2-human-decision
steps: (async()=>{const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {delayedDecision}=await import('/src/dev/sim/talkWork.ts');const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const h=window.__sim.host;const id=delayedDecision(h);const t=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===id);const r=h.runs.find(r=>r.run_id===t.current_run);localStorage.setItem('sim.human-decisions',JSON.stringify({[r.run_id]:{resolution:'mark_completed',at:Date.now(),by:{kind:'device',device_id:ids.device}}}));const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectTask(t.project_id,id);ui.selectTab('talk');ui.persistNow();setTimeout(()=>location.reload(),100)})()

const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Recover the interrupted migration'));if(!row?.textContent.includes('Marked completed'))throw Error('Human decision missing from task switcher');row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});

name: U15-7-terminal-keyboard-landscape
steps: const field=document.querySelector('.terminal-composer textarea');if(document.activeElement!==field)throw Error('Send line lost command focus');const output=document.querySelector('.terminal-output').getBoundingClientRect();const row=document.querySelector('.xterm-rows>div');const line=row?.getBoundingClientRect().height||17;if(output.height<line*4)throw Error('Fewer than four output lines fit: '+output.height);if(output.top<field.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)throw Error('Output overlaps command field');

name: U15-8-sheet-safety
steps: const page=document.querySelector('.app__safety');if(getComputedStyle(page).visibility!=='hidden')throw Error('Page Stop still visible');const sheet=document.querySelector('dialog[open] .sheet__urgent');if(!sheet||getComputedStyle(sheet).visibility!=='visible'||!sheet.querySelector('button'))throw Error('Sheet Stop unavailable');
